besluite.rede: 'ander is meestal klip en kaal rots' is natural Afrikaans and mirrors 'het sandduine'; the proposal is a longer lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'Die plaaslike naam' follows a sentence ending on the Zambezi, Zambia and Zimbabwe, so a Grade 5 reader may not know whose name it is.
besluite.rede: Naming the waterfall fixes an ambiguous reference without adding a fact or touching a protected wording.
